method: Four fresh paused native R7 idle samples at selected Clover source frames; record both decoded frames, media state and body bounds; two existing HUD publications before capture. No target/pose/shader substitutions.
review: Measure full captures and crop at1:1 around both media body bounds with16px padding, compose one two-cat strip per capture. View each strip once; never reopen earlier captures.
scope: Observe edge noise, dark fringe, glow continuity and stage scale in these four sampled poses; unknown original alpha prevents pixel-perfect halo recovery claims.
